review: Used the four named Sobha Palm Grove gallery images and six complete four-bedroom villa drawings from the brochure linked by the developer. The broker-hosted Phase 1 copy uses different saleable figures. The developer-linked drawing values govern the selector. The official brochure’s five- and six-bedroom Coral Beach plans are outside this project.
unavailable: No verified plot entrance coordinates or Palm Grove-specific interior illustration. The wider brochure’s mansion interiors were excluded.
